title: CNC Vertical Machining Center
subtitle: Three ballscrews, a 12,000 rpm spindle and a tool changer that swaps in two seconds
summary: A CNC machining centre moves a cutting tool through metal along three precise axes. Ballscrews turn servo rotation into straight motion, linear rails keep the slide aligned, and the spindle spins the tool. A tool changer swaps cutters between operations while the controller follows a program of coordinates.

parts.name: Base Casting
parts.short: The rigid foundation of the machine
parts.detail: A heavy casting that absorbs cutting vibration and carries the column and table slides.

parts.name: Column
parts.detail: The tall casting behind the table. Its stiffness decides how deeply the machine can cut without chatter.

parts.name: Enclosure
parts.detail: Panels and a sliding door keep swarf and coolant inside the working area.

parts.name: Worktable and Vise
parts.short: Holds the part under the spindle
parts.detail: A T-slotted table carries the vise. The table moves in X while the spindle moves in Y and Z.

parts.name: Saddle and Way Covers
parts.short: Supports the table on its rails
parts.detail: The saddle slides on the Y rails. Accordion covers keep chips off the precision ways.

parts.name: X Axis
parts.short: Moves the table left and right
parts.detail: Two rails guide the table while a ballscrew converts servo rotation into smooth linear motion.

parts.name: Y Axis
parts.short: Moves the spindle front and back
parts.detail: Vertical rails on the column guide the head. The ballscrew holds position against cutting force.

parts.name: Z Axis
parts.short: Feeds the tool into the part
parts.detail: The short vertical stroke that plunges the cutter. Its brake holds the head when power is off.

parts.name: Spindle Head
parts.short: The moving block that carries the spindle
parts.detail: A ribbed casting that slides on the Y and Z ways and holds the spindle cartridge.

parts.name: Spindle
parts.detail: A motor drives a precision spindle through a belt or direct coupling. The taper locates the tool holder.

parts.name: Tool Changer
parts.detail: A carousel stores tools in numbered pockets. The arm pulls one, inserts the next and returns to its rest position.

parts.name: Coolant System
parts.short: Cools the cut and flushes chips
parts.detail: A pump sends coolant through nozzles at the tool. It carries heat away and washes chips out of the cut.

parts.name: Chip Auger
parts.short: Screws metal chips out of the machine
parts.detail: A rotating screw moves chips to a bin outside the enclosure.

parts.name: Control Panel
parts.short: The operator's window into the program
parts.detail: The screen shows coordinates, tool number and feed rate. Buttons start, stop and jog the machine.

parts.name: Work Light
parts.detail: A bright ring light lets the operator see the cut through the door.

parts.name: Nameplate
parts.detail: The plate records the machine model, travels and serial number.

steps.title: A screw turns rotation into straight motion
steps.body: The servo turns a ballscrew. Recirculating balls make the nut travel with almost no friction or backlash, so a command of 0.01 mm actually moves 0.01 mm.

steps.title: Rails take the cutting force
steps.body: The table and head slide on hardened linear rails. They carry the load in every direction except travel, keeping the tool on its path.

steps.title: The spindle makes the cut
steps.body: The tool rotates while the axes feed it into the part. Coolant removes heat and flushes chips before they are recut.

steps.title: Tools change without stopping
steps.body: The program calls a tool number, the carousel indexes, and the arm swaps it into the spindle. The next operation starts without an operator touching the machine.

quiz.prompt: Tap the axis that feeds the tool into the workpiece.
Tap the part that spins the cutting tool.
Tap the system that removes heat and chips from the cut.
Why are ballscrews used instead of plain screws?
quiz.explain: Recirculating balls replace sliding friction with rolling contact, giving smooth, precise motion.

quiz.prompt: What does the tool changer do?
quiz.explain: The carousel stores tools and the arm exchanges the one in the spindle.
